environment.description: Django application deployed on EC2 instance with DOCUMENT_STORAGE_BACKEND='local' and DOCUMENT_ROOT='/var/app/documents'. The EC2 instance runs as root. No WAF or reverse proxy path normalization. The URL routing uses Django's <path:document_path> converter which permits slashes and dot-dot sequences. Instance IAM role has s3:GetObject and s3:PutObject on arn:aws:s3:::company-docs-prod/*.

config.deployment: EC2 bare metal, nginx passthrough, no path filtering
